title: U.S. House · Tennessee's 3rd District
area: Southeast Tennessee, including Chattanooga and Oak Ridge

context.text: Incumbent Charles J. "Chuck" Fleischmann (R) advanced unopposed from the August 6, 2026 Republican primary. Anna Golladay won the Democratic primary. The district's 2026 Cook Partisan Voter Index is R+18, and forecasters rate the general election Safe/Solid Republican.

candidates.name: Charles J. "Chuck" Fleischmann
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced unopposed from the August 6, 2026 Republican primary

positions.summary: His official issues page says he supports legislation that defunds, repeals and replaces Obamacare with free market solutions.
positions.quote: We must not only repeal Obamacare but replace it with free market solutions empowering our citizens.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations (2025-2026), chairing the Subcommittee on Energy and Water Development and Related Agencies, and also sits on the Labor, Health and Human Services, Education Subcommittee and the Defense Subcommittee.
Serves on the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology (2025-2026).

candidates.researchNotes: His official issues pages for immigration and border security call for more border patrol agents and enforcing existing law, which is general border-security language; no further positions recorded. The health care page is undated.

priorities.text: Says rising costs for groceries, housing, childcare, healthcare, and utilities are 'squeezing everyone who isn't a billionaire or a massive corporation.'
Cites Tennessee's decision not to expand Medicaid as a driver of the state's rural healthcare crisis.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists raising the federal minimum wage as a legislative priority, citing that 36% of Tennessee workers earn less than $15 an hour.
positions.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage - 36% of Tennessee workers earn less than $15/hour, so this puts real money back into the pockets of working families across District 3.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists protecting and expanding Medicare and the ACA as a priority and notes Tennessee has not expanded Medicaid.
positions.quote: Protect and Expand Medicare and the ACA - Defending Medicare and the ACA keeps affordable coverage in reach for TN seniors and working families alike.

positions.summary: Her campaign site calls for an annual wealth tax on billionaires and removing the Social Security payroll tax cap for high earners.
positions.quote: An annual wealth tax on billionaires' stock gains and closed-loop loans makes the ultra-wealthy pay their share

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists passing the Women's Health Protection Act, restoring the protections of Roe and Casey.
positions.quote: Pass the Women's Health Protection Act - Restoring the protections of Roe and Casey means Tennessee women get to make their own healthcare decisions again.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists support for stricter gun laws as a keeping-families-safe priority.
Her campaign site calls for sweeping divestment of ICE with ultimate abolishment and opposes 287(g) agreements.
positions.quote: Begin sweeping divestment of ICE with ultimate abolishment.

positions.summary: Her campaign site says she opposes the SAVE Act, which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote.
positions.quote: Oppose Voter Suppression and the SAVE Act

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists expanding TVA renewable energy programs.
Her campaign site says she opposes federal expansion of school voucher programs.
positions.quote: Oppose Federal Expansion of School Voucher Programs

priorities.text: Lists saving Social Security, fixing healthcare, lowering taxes on working Americans, and requiring congressional approval before military action as priorities.

positions.summary: Lists requiring congressional approval before war as a platform item.
positions.quote: No wars without congress giving approval

positions.summary: Lists universal health care as a platform item.
positions.quote: The richest, most blessed country in history can afford to supply the people with health care.

statements.quote: We must absolutely fund Social Security and those that have received all of the breaks must help paying for it.
statements.context: On his campaign website, on funding Social Security
On his campaign website's platform list

statements.quote: I believe in the “Right to Life”
statements.context: On his campaign website's platform list

priorities.text: Supports term limits of three terms for the House and two for the Senate.

Rodney King's Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses
Donnie Ownby's Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses

researchNotes: Chuck Fleischmann did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey for 2026; his federal key votes and FEC totals are added separately by script. Dean Arnold, Jean Howard-Hill, and Edward Roland are independent candidates with no discoverable campaign platform for 2026 beyond appearing on the ballot list. Rodney King was researched from his campaign website (his earlier 'opposes' gun-law entry was replaced with a statement, since support for the Second Amendment does not establish a stance on stricter gun laws). No campaign pages, questionnaires or coverage were found for Donnie Ownby, Dean Arnold, Jean Howard-Hill or Edward Roland beyond ballot listings; Jean Howard-Hill's campaign domain did not resolve. No biographical information beyond ballot appearance was found for Dean Arnold, Jean Howard-Hill, or Edward Roland.
